title: An unexpected opening
literal_meaning: As when the hanging sling breaks to the cat’s good fortune.
explanation: Something previously out of reach becomes available by chance. The cat benefits from a broken hanging food sling, rather than from a plan of its own.
meaning_odia: ଉପରେ ଝୁଲୁଥିବା ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବିରାଡ଼ିର ପହଞ୍ଚ ବାହାରେ ଥିଲା; ଶିକା ଛିଣ୍ଡିବାରୁ ସେହି ଜିନିଷ ମିଳିଗଲା। ନିଜ ଯୋଜନା ବା ପରିଶ୍ରମରୁ ନୁହେଁ, ଅପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଶିତ ଘଟଣାରୁ ସୁଯୋଗ ମିଳିଲେ ଏହି ଉପମା କୁହାଯାଏ। ଭାଗ୍ୟରେ ମିଳିଥିବା ଲାଭ ଓ ନିଜେ ହାସଲ କରିଥିବା ଫଳର ତଫାତ ଏଠାରେ ଦିଶେ।
usage_example: A cancellation unexpectedly frees a place on a fully booked course. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ଶିକା denotes a rope support for suspended vessels; its separate dictionary entry explains this comparison.
